package.name: agf_clearance_field_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo (classic 11, ROS Noetic) test bench for agf_clearance_field: a simplified AGF with a lifting fork carriage, a carried pallet + load, a vertical-plane 2D LiDAR and a lower stack. A scenario runner drives the AGF to the check position, reads field_clear and compares it with the ground-truth clearance and the physical outcome of driving over the stack.
